config.title: Configuration
config.intro: Start with the required items to get your workspace operational. Preferred settings improve consistency and speed, while optional items can be added anytime.

required.title: Required
required.desc: Suggested order: Permissions > Users > Workflows > Phases > Document Types. You can configure in any order, but this flow gets teams working fastest.

preferred.title: Preferred
preferred.desc: Recommended next to standardize content and speed up teams.

optional.title: Optional
optional.desc: Nice to have. Configure now or come back later based on need.

workflows.desc: Set up and manage workflow templates.

phases.label: Phases
